purpose: Test the original bidirectional stop-gradient mutual-distillation objective on top of the already learnable direct key/complete targets, without replacing or modifying that objective and without enabling gate alignment, reconstruction, containment, or any other CLIR module.

method.name: original_bidirectional_stop_gradient_mutual_distillation
method.attention_definition: A_key and A_complete are full-trajectory masked-softmax distributions from key_prior_logits and complete_prior_logits.
method.token_reduction: Sum squared token errors within each trajectory, then average trajectories independently in each direction.
method.weight_rationale: Preserve the original implementation default. In the completed D3 logs, the unweighted joint distillation diagnostic was finite and nonzero (approximately 0.003 to 0.023 across train epochs), so 0.25 is a modest active coefficient rather than an inert or dominating term.

m0_direct_no_distill.description: Matched D3 control: correctness plus direct key and complete BCE, with mutual distillation disabled.

m1_original_mutual_distill.description: Correctness plus direct key and complete BCE plus the original bidirectional stop-gradient mutual-attention MSE at weight 0.25.

evaluation.primary_collaboration_metric: Held-out mean symmetric attention MSE, numerically equal to the two-direction joint distillation formula evaluated without gradients.
evaluation.membership_prediction: sigmoid(key_prior_logits) and sigmoid(complete_prior_logits), never trajectory-softmax attention
evaluation.attention_prediction: full-trajectory clir_key_prior and clir_complete_prior masked-softmax distributions
metrics: train and dev one-direction and symmetric attention MSE, attention L1 distance, and overlap mass
held-out key and complete token/unit average precision
key/complete membership probability separation and correlation
calibrated containment violation as a diagnostic only
evaluation.passing_conclusion: The preserved original mutual-distillation objective is active and reduces its held-out branch-discrepancy target without unacceptable localization, map-separation, or correctness regression in this pipeline pilot. Advance it as the dual-prior collaboration method; downstream reward-gate efficacy remains untested.
evaluation.failing_conclusion: Keep the original mutual-distillation mechanism in the method and report this frozen setting as diagnostic-only. Diagnose coefficient scale or joint-versus-alternate scheduling under a separately frozen protocol; do not replace its formula post hoc and do not claim collaboration efficacy from this run.
